hardwareHubs.note: Nebraska Innovation Studio on Nebraska Innovation Campus and MakeShift Lincoln both offer laser cutters and CNC routers.
Metro Community College's Prototype Design Lab lists 3D printers, laser cutters, CNC machines and welders.

makerspaces.name: Nebraska Innovation Studio
makerspaces.note: Lists lasers, 3D printers, a CNC router, wood shop and metal-working shop at 2021 Transformation Drive.

makerspaces.name: MakeShift Lincoln
makerspaces.note: Lists a 100 W laser cutter, CNC routers, 3D printers, MIG welders and an oscilloscope.

makerspaces.name: Metro Community College Prototype Design Lab
makerspaces.note: Lists 3D printers, laser cutters, CNC routers, a CNC plasma table and welders.

specialties.name: Food manufacturing
specialties.note: The state labor department reports food manufacturing is the largest manufacturing subsector, with 41,254 jobs in Q1 2024.

specialties.name: Center-pivot irrigation equipment
specialties.note: The state economic development department says Nebraska is a global center-pivot manufacturing leader, led by Lindsay, Reinke, T-L Irrigation and Valmont.

specialties.name: Machinery and agricultural equipment
specialties.note: A University of Nebraska-Lincoln report says machine manufacturing, including agricultural machinery, is 11% of state manufacturing employment.

support.name: Nebraska Manufacturing Extension Partnership (Nebraska MEP)
support.note: NIST MEP center at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln serving Nebraska manufacturers.
